description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to app store metadata, including retrieving app data, filtering apps based on credentials, and supporting app-related operations such as support checks and sanitization.

methods.name: getApps
methods.description: Retrieves all available apps for a user based on their credentials, including globally available apps, with optional filtering based on credentials.

methods.name: getLocalAppMetadata
methods.description: Returns the local list of all app metadata.

methods.name: hasIntegrationInstalled
methods.description: Checks if an app of a specific type is installed.

methods.name: getAppName
methods.description: Gets the display name of an app given its internal name.

methods.name: getAppType
methods.description: Determines the app type category based on its name suffix.

methods.name: getAppFromSlug
methods.description: Finds app metadata by its slug.

methods.name: getAppFromLocationValue
methods.description: Finds app metadata by location type.

methods.name: doesAppSupportTeamInstall
methods.description: Determines if an app supports team installation based on categories, concurrency, and payment status.

methods.name: isConferencing
methods.description: Checks if app categories include conferencing or video.

methods.name: sanitizeAppForViewer
methods.description: Removes sensitive fields from app data for viewer display.
